datasets.name: bed02bd2
queryLines:
WITH RECURSIVE col_downstream(source_table, source_col, target_table, target_col, dependency_level) AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CONCAT(:catalog, '.', :schema, '.', :table_name), source_column_name,
    target_table_full_name, target_column_name, 1
  FROM system.access.column_lineage
  WHERE source_table_catalog = :catalog
    AND source_table_schema = :schema
    AND source_table_name = :table_name
    AND source_column_name = :column_name
    AND target_table_full_name IS NOT NULL
    AND target_column_name IS NOT NULL
    AND target_table_full_name != CONCAT(:catalog, '.', :schema, '.', :table_name)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT cd.target_table, cd.target_col,
    cl.target_table_full_name, cl.target_column_name, cd.dependency_level + 1
  FROM col_downstream cd
  JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT source_table_full_name, source_column_name, target_table_full_name, target_column_name
    FROM system.access.column_lineage
    WHERE target_table_full_name IS NOT NULL AND target_column_name IS NOT NULL AND source_column_name IS NOT NULL
  ) cl ON cl.source_table_full_name = cd.target_table AND cl.source_column_name = cd.target_col
  WHERE cd.dependency_level < 10
    AND cl.target_table_full_name != CONCAT(:catalog, '.', :schema, '.', :table_name)
    AND NOT (cl.target_table_full_name = cd.target_table AND cl.target_column_name = cd.target_col)
    AND NOT (cl.target_table_full_name = cd.source_table AND cl.target_column_name = cd.source_col)
)
SELECT target_table, target_col,
  MIN(dependency_level) as dependency_level
FROM col_downstream
GROUP BY target_table, target_col

  FROM col_upstream cu
  JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT source_table_full_name, source_column_name, target_table_full_name, target_column_name
